title: The room's tick loop: start, pace, stop
oneLine: The 45 Hz heartbeat's handle, pacer re-arms and stop on the last close, across index.js, tick.js, tickpace.js.
topConcern: Party tick, regen, flush, AFK sweep and the whole send loop run outside the per-system guard; one repeating throw silences the room.

title: Idle (AFK) and never-joined socket eviction
oneLine: A session's activity clock, stamped by move signature, swept every ~3 s with close 4006.

title: The dead/dying pair, with the phone writing dead on every move
oneLine: Worker's dying/respawn plus the phone's dead flag, overwritten by every accepted move and trusted by targeting.
topConcern: A phone sending dead:true while alive is skipped by every monster and PvP hit loop yet still attacks monsters: god mode.

title: The shield: down, raised (parry window), held, guard-broken
oneLine: Phone-written blocking, the server-stamped raise time that opens the parry window, and the guard-break latch.
topConcern: Toggling blocking every move re-arms the 250 ms parry window endlessly: near-every blocked blow parried, free, stamina back, attacker staggered.

title: The move budget: first move, judged, followed, way back into the Wheel
oneLine: Anti-teleport budget, the tick's follow, and the way-back/arrival holders deciding where a move is judged from.
topConcern: A follow moves the copy with no race or ride check; many holders and two kill switches decide judging.

title: The glide (message diet): a steady walk moved between moves
oneLine: ps._mp glide between a phone's pd:1 moves, stopped by any foreign write, rewound before the next judge.
topConcern: A ride ended by a hit clears the glide without rewinding, so one move is judged from the glided spot.

title: Steady movers: a walker's update held for the next tick
oneLine: Per-player last-sent record deciding hold-or-send of a Wheel walker's update each tick.

title: Sprint: a step the worker pays for, a run, the grace after
oneLine: Per-move sprint step, run continuity, stamina billing, grace and wire/regen windows from five underscore fields.
topConcern: With the diet's 200 ms gaps, the stretch before a non-sprint stop goes unbilled; small and by design.

title: The skateboard ride
oneLine: ps._ride on/off with toggle cooldown, ended by edge, zone, death, hit, fighting, duel, kill switch, ask.
topConcern: Ride ends only on an accepted move; glide and follow can carry a rider past the safe edge still drawn on the board.

title: Lil Bro's race
oneLine: ps._race countdown, false start, five flags along each step, win/lose, ended only from accepted moves.
topConcern: No sweep ends a stale race (ride refused 'busy'); a death does not end it while the phone's copy keeps its own clock.

title: Rest and Well Rested
oneLine: A gated rest filling pools and stamping the saved Well Rested buff, with a memory-only minute gap.
topConcern: A reconnect lets one rest through early (documented, costs one row).

title: The paid roll window
oneLine: Phone's dodging counts only inside the window a charged dodge/lunge/retreat opened (1000 ms).
topConcern: Monster-blow i-frames ignore a daze or freeze while both player-blow readers refuse a dazed roll.

title: A player's elemental statuses from monster hits
oneLine: Chill, freeze, stuck, daze, soak and gust-room windows stamped by the worker, mostly carried out by the phone.
topConcern: Of a daze's 'no walk, swing, roll or shield' the worker enforces only PvP swings, PvP rolls and ability strikes.

title: Burns, poisons and stings on a player
oneLine: Per-player DOT Maps refreshed by hits and swept every tick by every exit.
topConcern: Put-out reads the phone-written ps.dead (part of S3-3).

title: Zone change and the zone-entry grace
oneLine: Phone-chosen zone per move: snapshot, per-zone resets and a 500 ms damage-immunity grace on each entry.
topConcern: A two-move bundle wheel→dungeon:x→wheel re-arms the grace at no position cost; repeated, permanent immunity (monsters and PvP).

title: Who a phone is sent about: far players, the slim roster, presence v2
oneLine: Room and session holders deciding whole, slim, skipped or hidden player entries in each phone's tick.
topConcern: Four kill switches, two dormant paths and per-session flags must agree across both tick builders.

title: The Wheel's monster interest per phone
oneLine: Per-session seen/entered monster sets with in/out hysteresis, forgotten outside the Wheel.
topConcern: A target dropped out of reach never reaches the phone, so the next notice of you shows no '!' cue.

title: Wheel monsters awake or resting, and the safe ground's shelter vs provoke
oneLine: Per-tick rest test for far monsters and the safe ground's shelter unless the player provoked the monster.
topConcern: The 'nothing in flight' list is hand-written in three places; each new monster phase must join all three.

title: Which Wheel the room plays and a phone in or out of step
oneLine: Room latches long/short Wheel once; each player in or out of step by the sizes its phone declared.
topConcern: A phone declaring ws:[1] (or none) is never a monster's target or hit, yet may attack monsters freely.

title: Monster moves past tier 1
oneLine: Per-monster wind-up, strike, dash, flight, cooldowns, enrage and live stat step in thirteen _mv fields.
topConcern: A monster killed mid-volley drops balls the phone was told to land; reset lists kept by hand.

title: Population-scaled spawns
oneLine: Held zone population with instant rise and slow decay growing and trimming scaled monsters and nodes.
topConcern: Runs only for zones with a config; the Wheel has none, so only the closed old lands reach it.

title: Threats: countdown, guards or consent
oneLine: Threat pairs with countdown, guards fine and gear lock, consent window and bounty payout.
topConcern: Dormant: OPEN_PVP is false; gearlock storage keys are never deleted.

title: Cadence: the login streak and the weekly jackpot
oneLine: Stored login streak with freezes and the lazily settled, opId-stamped weekly jackpot draw.
topConcern: A retry after a restart re-rolls the winner: payment is dup-safe but the announcement names the wrong player.

title: stats_update: the legacy skill tracks' level-up full restore
oneLine: Phone-reported legacy weapon/defence skill levels; any increase fills HP, stamina and mana.
topConcern: Under prog3 honest phones never raise these tracks, so each forged +1 is a free full heal, ~400 per character.

title: Legacy build points, T2 allocation and the pre-prog3 level
oneLine: Build points to level, T2 spend, bench-priced t2Flat and the 1000-point ceiling, all off under prog3.

title: The harvest activity code (ex) and the cook/fire shield it arms
oneLine: Phone-written ex whose null-to-active edge anchors the cook/fire harvest shield that monsters respect.
topConcern: Swing, then ex:null and ex:'cook' in one bundle re-arms the shield before any tick: monsters never fight back.

title: The lag-compensation history
oneLine: Per-player ring of 14 reused tick snapshots read by the PvP rewind, deleted on every way out.
